mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are enjoying clear skies near the Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 78 degrees under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on September 8th to discuss various development projects, including an initial review for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park. Also, the city has officially announced the four student winners of the I Voted sticker contest, whose artwork will be featured on stickers at the polls for the November 3 General Election.

Today, you can attend the UGM event at Epic Systems or join a yoga class at Insight Wellness. Looking forward to tomorrow, check out trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and don't miss live music at Paddy Mac's or the farmer's market.
A notable call for service occurred on August 15 when officers responded to a reckless driving report, resulting in the arrest of a 29-year-old local man for his second O W I offence.
You are going to love today's Flavor of the Day, which is Caramel Peanut Buttercup at Culver's, and as a bonus, the Kona Ice truck will be at the Concerts at McKee from 5 PM to 9 PM today.
